text:
anna_w: Quick sanity check — I ran a correlation across the last 24h of Xid logs vs tenant workload mix. Seeing a concentrated spike around 03:10 UTC tied to long-decode chat sessions on A10s in us-west2 rack7b.

kevin_c: Can you paste the query + a couple sample rows?

anna_w: 
```
SELECT xid, gpu_model, rack, tenant_id, op_type, start_ts
FROM gpu_xid_events
WHERE start_ts > now() - interval '24 hours'
AND xid IN (13,31,48,79)
ORDER BY start_ts desc
LIMIT 20;
```

Sample rows:
```
xid=31, model=A10, rack=rack7b, tenant=chat-ux, op=decode, ts=2025-11-15T03:10:12Z
xid=13, model=A10, rack=rack7b, tenant=search-embed, op=embeddings, ts=2025-11-15T03:10:15Z
xid=48, model=A10, rack=rack7b, tenant=chat-ux, op=decode, ts=2025-11-15T03:10:17Z
```

maria_ops: :thinking_face: that rack had maintenance earlier? any recent drains or cable work?

infra-bot: Alert: GPU XID spike detected — threshold crossed on rack7b A10 pool (xid 31/48). See /incidents/1999 for details.

oliver: I noticed elevated DRAM ECC counters on node rack7b-12 in telemetry last night, but node never auto-drained.

kevin_c: Are the events tenant-specific or op-type specific? From the rows it looks decode-heavy (long streaming).

anna_w: Mostly decode / chat long streaming for chat-ux. Embeddings show scattered xid13s across tenants when sequence lengths exceed ~2k.

sam_sre: Could be KV cache pressure + sustained compute causing register spills. Historically NVLink retry storms show up as xid31.

kevin_c: Quick mapping (draft): 13=memory ECC, 31=nvlink/driver retries, 48=decode/kernel driver, 79=thermal/oom-ish. Need confirmation.

maria_ops: Can we get p95 latency + concurrency around the spike window? helps tell if workload drove it.

anna_w: p95 token latency jumped from ~120ms -> ~460ms during the spike. batch sizes unchanged, concurrent streams increased x2.

oliver: Rack7b nodes still on driver 525.92 vs fleet baseline 525.99 — nvlink fixes in .99 reduced Xid31 noise in previous patches.

kevin_c: Proposed quick plan:
- short: divert chat-ux traffic off rack7b to us-west2-burst pool for 2h
- medium: cordon/reroute nodes rack7b-10..13, run memtest + driver bump to 525.99
- long: add workload-level backpressure when seq_len > 2048 for chat streaming

maria_ops: I'll schedule reroute, assigning to @kevin_c for immediate change.

kevin_c: On it — creating reroute and dry-run now.

infra-bot: deploy-bot: routing-policy update applied for tenant chat-ux -> us-west2-burst (dry-run) by kevin_c at 03:25 UTC

kevin_c: reroute applied (dry-run). monitoring for 20m.

anna_w: After reroute p95 dropped back to ~130ms, Xid31 events in rack7b fell ~90%.

oliver: I'll open a hardware ticket for nodes 10-13 and schedule driver upgrade + memtest overnight.

sam_sre: Also adding a synthetic test to nightly that simulates long decode sessions with KV cache pressure — should catch regressions before rollout.

maria_ops: Closing loop: owner = kevin_c for reroute, hardware ticket TL = oliver, regression PR owner = sam_sre. Reopen if spike reappears.

kevin_c: noted. :thumbsup:
